scenes.text: Claude built it in four phases, one prompt each. Here's Lee's draft report. A dinner over the meals limit needs an explanation, and a hotel has no receipt.

But the useful part is what broke. The seed data loaded relative to today, while the checks used fixed dates. Two rules named different people who can see a receipt. And changing a report's approver had no event and no email.

Expensify's Submit plan is free. Reimbursements and approvals come with Collect, at five dollars per member per month. If you just pay back a small team, you mostly need receipts, one approval, and a record of payment.
